parsed.rationale: Two identical `extension SwiftUI.Image` declarations exist in separate targets — `app:WatchXYC` at `WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:190` and `app:iOS` at `WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift:27` — with `shared_field_count: 2` and no differing slots, confirming exact duplication. Neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flag, so the duplication is unintentional. The extension should be extracted to a shared module (e.g., a `SharedUI` or `Common` framework) that both `WatchXYC` and `iOS` targets already depend on, or at minimum consolidated into a single shared file such as a new `WXYC/Shared/Extensions/Image+Extensions.swift`. The inline placement of the WatchXYC copy inside `PlayerPage.swift` further suggests it was added ad-hoc rather than by design.
